name: social-creative
description: Research social marketing, write content, design static visuals, and produce videos using project-specific brand context.

interface.shortDescription: Research, plan, write, design, and edit social content.
interface.longDescription: Includes social-marketer for project research, channel strategy, campaigns, and strategic outcome review; social-content for posts, scripts, repurposing, and calendars; social-designer for static visuals; and video-editor for reels, explainers, talking-head edits, animation, and longer videos.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research or create social content, visuals, or videos using this project's brand context and goals.
